verifications.claim: Artemis II is carrying four astronauts on a 10-day mission to fly around the Moon and return to Earth.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Four people are on their way to the Moon... slingshot around the Moon’s far side'; R2: '10-day mission... around the moon'; R3: 'four astronauts... 10-day mission... orbit the Moon'; R4: 'TEN DAY MISSION'; R5: '10-day mission'; R6: '10-day mission around the Moon and back'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly confirm four astronauts, 10-day duration, fly-around trajectory, and return to Earth.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first crewed mission to the lunar vicinity since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first time since Apollo astronauts... more than 50 years ago'; R2: 'last time... Apollo 17, in December 1972'; R3: 'first time since 1972'; R5: 'first crewed moon mission in more than 50 years'; R6: 'first humans back to the Moon in over 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state it is the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 in 1972.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will test the Orion spacecraft's systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'test how well the Orion capsule... in deep space'; R2: 'check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey'; R3: 'verify modern human capabilities in deep space'; R4: 'prove life support, operations... with astronauts'; R5: 'test all of Orion’s systems'; R6: 'test Orion’s systems in their intended environment'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe testing Orion systems during deep space phase of the mission.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will swing around the far side of the Moon before splashing down in the Pacific Ocean.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm flyby around far side followed by Pacific splashdown.

verifications.claim: The destination of the Artemis II mission is a lunar flyby orbiting the Moon rather than landing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'flew around the Moon... slingshot around the Moon’s far side'; R2: 'around the moon but not land there'; R3: 'orbit the Moon... around the Moon'; R6: 'around the Moon... lunar flyby'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm flyby around Moon without landing; phrasing 'flyby orbiting' is slightly imprecise but directly supported as non-landing lunar trajectory.
